title: THIS MORNING PRAYER ATTRACTS MIRACLES LIKE A MAGNET
text: Stop whatever you are doing, stop scrolling, stop multitasking, stop dividing your attention. What is about to happen in the next few moments is not entertainment, it is not content, it is not background noise. What is about to happen is an encounter with the living God. And encounters are not passive, they demand your full participation, they require your complete surrender. So, right now put everything else down, >> [music] >> close every other tab, silence every notification, tell the world to wait because God will not wait. He is here and he's ready to move. The spirit of the Lord spoke to me before this service began and he said something strange. He said, "Tell my people that I am tired of doing small things in their lives. I am tired of giving them drops when I have oceans. I am tired of handing them crumbs when I have banquets. The limitation has never been on my end. The limitation has always been on their end, in their faith, in their expectations, in their prayers. Today, I want to break the ceiling. Today, I want to shatter the glass. Today, I want to do something so extraordinary, so outrageous, so unprecedented that the only explanation will be G.O.D. Did you hear that? Before we sing a single note of worship, before we read a single verse of scripture, I need you to hear what the spirit is saying. He wants to do something massive, not small, not moderate, not reasonable, massive. The kind of miracles that make newspaper headlines, the kind of breakthroughs that make your enemies weep, the kind of turnarounds that make skeptics believe, but he needs your faith. He needs your expectation. He needs your hunger. He needs your desperation because miracles are not attracted by comfort, miracles are not attracted by indifference. Miracles are attracted by hunger. Miracles are attracted by desperation. Miracles are attracted by radical, unreasonable, illogical faith. Now, before we go further, do something for me. Share this broadcast immediately. Do not wait until the end. Share it now. There is someone in your contact list right now who has been crying for a miracle. There is someone on your timeline right now who has been fasting and praying and nothing has happened. There is someone in your family right now who is on the verge of giving up. And God wants to use your hands, your phone, your share button to deliver a miracle to their doorstep. You are not just a listener, you are a distributor of grace, you are a courier of heaven. Share this message now and the same miracle you deliver to others will find its way back to you. That is how the kingdom works. Now, lift your hands. We're entering into worship, but not ordinary worship. This morning I want worship that pulls heaven down. I want worship that creates a magnetic field in the spirit realm. I want worship that makes miracles unavoidable. Father, we worship you, we honor you, we adore you. There is no one in the heavens who can be compared to you. There is no one among the sons of the mighty who can be likened to you. >> [music] >> You are God alone, self-existing, self-sufficient, eternal, immutable, omniscient, omnipresent, omnipotent. All power belongs to you. All wisdom flows from you. All knowledge originates in you. You spoke and galaxies formed. You breathed and mankind lived. You whispered and seas obeyed. What manner of God is this? What kind of king is this? Who is like you? Nobody. Not even close. Not in a million years, not in a billion eternities. You are alone in your class. You are singular in your majesty and we bow. We bow with everything within us. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Let me hear you worship in your own words now. Open your mouth and talk to God directly. Not through me, not through a song, directly. Tell him what is in your heart. Tell him what you need. Tell him what you are believing for. Let your worship become personal. Let it become intimate. Let it become a private conversation between you and the creator of the universe. Yes, Lord. Yes, Lord. We receive We receive your presence. We receive your power. We receive your anointing. We receive whatever you want to release in this service. Our hearts are open. Our hands are stretched. >> [music] >> Our spirits are ready. Do what only you can do. One more time, let the song change. Let the atmosphere intensify. >> [music] >> Way maker, miracle worker, promise keeper, light in the darkness, [music] my God, that is who you are. Way maker, miracle worker, promise keeper, light in the darkness, my God, that is who you are. You are here moving in our midst. I worship you. I worship you. You are here working in this place. I worship you. I worship you. You are here. He's here. The miracle worker is in the room. The promise keeper is in this service. The way maker is in this atmosphere. And if he's here, if the God who split the Red Sea is here, if the God who raised the dead is here, if the God who healed the leper with a touch is here, then anything is possible. Anything. Somebody shout, "Anything is possible." Hallelujah. Take your seat. Take your seat, but let your spirit remain standing at attention before the Lord. Because what I am about to teach you is going to transform the way you pray. It is going to revolutionize the way you approach God. It is going to give you a key, a spiritual key that will unlock a dimension of miracles you have never experienced before. Now, listen to me. Go with me to Mark chapter 11, verses 22 to 24. Jesus is speaking, and he says, "Have faith in God. For verily I say unto you, that whosoever shall say unto this mountain, be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea, and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass, he shall have whatsoever he saith. Therefore, I say unto you, what things soever you desire, when you pray, believe that you receive them, and you shall have them." Read that again, slowly. "What things soever you desire, when you pray, believe that you receive them, and you shall have them." This is not a motivational quote. This is not a feel-good statement. This is a spiritual law. This is a kingdom principle. This is the operating system of heaven. Jesus is telling us how miracles work. He's revealing the mechanism. He's exposing the technology of the supernatural. And here is the key. Believe that you receive them. Not believe that you will receive them someday. Not believe that you might receive them if God wills it. Believe that you receive them, present tense, right now, in the moment of prayer. The miracle is attracted by present tense faith. The miracle is magnetized by now believe, not future hope. Now faith. That is why this prayer attracts miracles like a magnet because a magnet does not chase iron. A magnet does not beg iron to come. A magnet does not negotiate with iron. A magnet simply eyes what it is and iron has no choice but to respond. When you pray with present tense now faith, when you believe that you receive at the moment of prayer, you become a spiritual magnet and miracles have no choice but to come to you. They are drawn. They are pulled. They are compelled by the force of your faith. Now go with me to one more scripture. Hebrews chapter 11 verse 1. Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen. Faith is substance. It is not wishful thinking. It is not daydreaming. It is not positive affirmation. Faith is spiritual substance. It has weight. It has density. It has mass. In the realm of the spirit, faith is a real, tangible, material substance. And when this substance comes into contact with the promises of God, it creates a reaction, a supernatural chemical reaction that produces miracles. Think of it like this. When you bring a magnet close to iron filings, the filings jump. They move. They are drawn toward the magnet without any effort from the magnet. The magnet does not strain. The magnet does not sweat. The magnet does not beg. It simply carries a force field, a magnetic field that makes iron respond. Faith is your magnetic field. When you carry genuine, word-based, spirit-filled faith, miracles respond. They jump toward you. They move in your direction. >> [music] >> They are pulled into your orbit. Opportunities come, doors open, people are sent, resources appear, healing manifests, deliverance happens, not because you begged, not because you manipulated, but because you carry the right substance. You carried faith, and that is what we are building in this service today. We are not just praying prayers. We are building a magnetic field. We are constructing a spiritual force field around your life that will attract miracles like iron filings to a magnet. By the time this service is over, miracles will be chasing you. Breakthroughs will be running after you. Blessings will be pursuing you. You will not need to chase anything. Everything you need will be drawn to you by the force of what God has deposited in your spirit today. Somebody shout, "I am a miracle magnet." Say it again, "I am a miracle magnet." Hallelujah. Now, let me take you deeper because I want to show you something that most people miss, and it is hidden in a very familiar story. Go with me to 2 Kings chapter 4 verses 1 through 7. This is the story of the widow whose husband died and left her in debt. The creditors were coming to take her two sons as slaves. She had nothing. She was empty. She was desperate, and she went to the prophet Elisha. Now, watch what Elisha did. He did not give her money. He did not pay her debts. He did not call the creditors and negotiate. Instead, he asked her a question, "What hast thou in the house?" >> [snorts] >> And she said, "Thy handmaid hath not anything in the house save a pot of oil." A pot of [music] oil. That is all she had. A small, insignificant, seemingly useless pot of oil. But Elisha saw something she did not see. He saw a miracle hidden inside her insufficiency. He saw abundance disguised as lack. He saw a river pretending to be a droplet, and he gave her instructions. He said, "Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbors, even empty vessels. Borrow not a few." "And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full." So, she went, she borrowed vessels, and she began to pour, and the oil kept flowing, vessel after vessel after vessel. The oil did not stop until she ran out of vessels. When there were no more vessels, the oil stopped. Now, here's the revelation. The miracle was not limited by the oil. The miracle was limited by the vessels. The oil, which represents the [music] power and provision of God, was unlimited. It could have filled a thousand vessels, it could have filled a million, but it only filled as many as she prepared. Her vessels were her faith in action. Her borrowing of vessels was her expectation in motion, and the number of vessels she borrowed determined the size of her miracle. This is critical. The size of your miracle is determined by the size of your expectation. The magnitude of your breakthrough is proportional to the magnitude of your faith. God can do exceedingly, abundantly above all that you ask or think. Ephesians chapter 3 verse 20. But, he operates according to the power that works in you. If there is limited faith working in you, you'll get a limited miracle. If there is unlimited faith working in you, you'll get an unlimited miracle. So, I am asking you today, how many vessels are you bringing? How big is your expectation? How wide is your faith? How deep is your hunger? Because the oil is ready to flow. The miracle is ready to manifest. >> [music] >> The breakthrough is ready to come, but it needs a container. It needs a vessel. It needs faith to land on. Do not come to God with a teaspoon when he wants to fill an ocean. Do not bring a thimble when he has a waterfall. Do not limit the Holy One of Israel. Psalm 78:141 warns us about the children of Israel. They turned back and tempted God and limited the Holy One of Israel. Do not limit God with small prayers. Do not limit God with small expectations. Do not limit God with small thinking. He is a big I G God. He does big I G things. He specializes in the impossible. He thrives in the ridiculous. He operates in the realm of the outrageous. And he's waiting for someone, just one person, who will dare to believe him for something massive. Is that person you? Is it you who will dare to believe that the sickness is healed? Is it you who will dare to believe that the debt is canceled? Is it you who will dare to believe that the marriage is restored? Is it you who will dare to believe that the business will succeed? >> [music] >> Is it you who will dare to believe that the child will come home? Is it you who will dare to believe that the door will open? If it is you, then get ready. Because what happens next in this service is going to be the most powerful prayer encounter of your life. We are about to enter into the kind of prayer that pulls miracles from the heavens. The kind of prayer that commands circumstances to change. The kind of prayer that makes the impossible bow to the name of Jesus. James chapter 5:16, the effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much. Effectual, fervent. These are not calm words. These are not gentle words. These are fire words. Effectual means it produces results. Fervent means it burns with intensity. This is not lukewarm prayer. This is boiling hot, white flame, volcanic prayer, and it avails much, not a little, much. Stand to your feet. Stand now. Your posture matters. When a soldier goes to war, he does not sit in a recliner. He stands in formation. He grips his weapon. He focuses his eyes on the enemy. You are about to go to war in the spirit. You are about to engage principalities and powers. You are about to confront rulers of darkness and spiritual wickedness in high places. Ephesians chapter 6:12. So, stand. Stand with authority. Stand with confidence. Stand with the knowledge that the God who has called you into this prayer is the same God who has already won the battle. The victory is not in question. The outcome is not in doubt. Christ has already triumphed. Colossians chapter 2:15. And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it. He has already spoiled principalities. He has already disarmed powers. He has already triumphed. And now, through prayer, we enforce that triumph. We apply that victory. We manifest that dominion. We take what Christ won, and we bring it into our daily experience. Are you ready? Then let us pray. Father, in the name that is above every name, the name at which every knee must bow, in heaven, on earth, and under the earth, the name that demons fear and angels worship. The name that sickness cannot resist and death cannot overpower. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, we come before you now. We come as magnetic vessels. We come as containers of faith. We come with expectation that fills the room. We come with hunger that shakes the heavens. We are not here for a routine. We are not here for a ritual. We are here for miracles, raw, undeniable, earth-shaking, story-changing miracles. And we believe we believe that as we pray, as we decree, as we declare, miracles are being attracted to us right now like iron to a magnet, like water to a valley, like light to darkness, miracles are coming. Miracles are moving. Miracles are here. Now, open your mouth and pray. Pray like your miracle depends on it because it does. Pray like your breakthrough is tied to your volume because it is. Pray like heaven is listening because heaven is listening. Say this with me. Father, I activate the magnetic force of faith in my life today. I am not an ordinary person. I am a carrier of the power of God. I am a vessel of the anointing of the Most High. And I decree that from this moment forward, miracles are attracted to my life, [music] good things are drawn to me, open doors are magnetized to me. Divine connections are pulled toward me. Financial breakthrough is rushing in my direction. Healing is manifesting in my body. Deliverance is overtaking my household. Miracles, miracles, miracles, come now. In the name of Jesus. Yakatay, moreshundai, sekaylay, tundrabai, presundai, lorimashi, shekaylundai, >> [music] >> presimashi, tundrabashundai, moreshundai, yak Loreshundai. Prethundai. Sekailai. Oh, something just broke in the spirit. I heard it. I heard the sound of chains snapping. I heard the sound of prison doors creaking open. I heard the sound of iron gates swinging on their hinges. Something that has been locked is being unlocked right now. Something that has been sealed is being opened right now. Something that has been caged is being released right now. Do not stop praying. Increase the intensity. Push harder. Press deeper. The breakthrough is so close you can almost touch it. Now, I want to pray specifically for miracle attraction in your destiny because the enemy has been working overtime to make your life repel blessings instead of attract them. He has placed spiritual coatings on some of your lives invisible barriers that cause good things to slide off you. Opportunities come close but never land. Connections form but never solidify. Breakthroughs approach but always divert at the last moment. It is not coincidence. It is a spiritual operation and we are dismantling it today. Father, I come against every spiritual barrier that has been placed around the life of everyone under the sound of my voice. Every invisible wall that has prevented blessings from reaching them, I command it to crumble now. Every spiritual coating that has made their lives repel goodness, I strip it off now. Every demonic shield that has deflected miracles away from their orbit, I shatter it now in the name of Jesus. I speak to every cause of near misses. You know what I'm talking about. You almost get the job but they call someone else. You almost close the deal but the other party changes their mind. You almost get the visa but the officer says no. You almost get married, but the relationship falls apart. You almost succeed, but something always goes wrong at the last minute. That is not bad luck. That is a cause of near miss, and I break it today in the name of Jesus Christ. Every cause of near miss over your life is broken. From today, you will not almost make it, you will make it. You will not almost succeed, you will succeed. >> [music] >> You will not almost receive, you will receive. The days of close but not quite are finished. Your next attempt will not be a near miss, it will be a direct hit, a bull's eye, a complete, total, undeniable success. Deuteronomy chapter 28 verse 13, "And the Lord shall make thee the head and not the tail, and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath, if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the Lord thy God, which I command thee this day to observe and to do them. The head and not the tail, above and not beneath, first and not last, leading and not following, winning and not losing. This is your decree. This is your portion. This is your inheritance in Christ, and no demon in hell can change what God has spoken over your life. Now, let us pray for family deliverance because for some of you, the reason miracles have been scarce is because there is a family pattern working against you. There is a generational current flowing in the wrong direction. Your parents struggled, your grandparents struggled, your great-grandparents struggled, and unless that current is reversed, you will struggle, too. But I have good news. The blood of Jesus is more powerful than any bloodline. The cross of Christ is stronger than any family altar. The name of Jesus is mightier than any ancestral covenant. And what flows through your veins by natural birth is overruled by what flows through your spirit by supernatural rebirth. 2 Corinthians chapter 5:17. Therefore, if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature. All things are passed away. Behold, all things are become new. You are a new creature. You are not a continuation of your family's failures. You are not an extension of your bloodline struggles. You are new. You are fresh. You are original. You are a first edition creation of the most high God. And the patterns of the past have no legal right to dictate the trajectory of your future. Pray with me now. Pray aggressively. In the name of Jesus, I break every generational pattern of miracle drought in my family, where my parents never experience supernatural breakthrough. I decree that [music and singing] the pattern ends with me. Where my ancestors lived and died without seeing the hand of God move mightily, I decree that the drought is over. The rain of miracles is falling on my generation. The outpouring of signs and wonders is beginning in my household. My children will see miracles. My grandchildren will walk in the supernatural. My lineage will be known as a miracle lineage from this day forward. Every family altar that has been working against the manifestation of miracles in my bloodline be consumed by fire right now. Every ancestral spirit that has been assigned to ensure that my family never prospers be bound and cast out now. Every evil dedication that was performed over my bloodline at a river, at a shrine, at a crossroad, at a graveyard, I cancel it by the blood of the lamb. My family belongs to Jesus Christ. We are under the covenant of grace. We are protected by the blood of the cross. And no weapon, no altar, no covenant, no curse, no spell formed against my family shall prosper. >> [music] >> I hear the spirit of God, there is a family listening right now. Three generations of women in your family have experienced the same pattern, abandonment by their husbands. Your grandmother was abandoned. Your mother was abandoned, and now you are afraid that you will be abandoned, too. The spirit [music] of God is saying the pattern is broken. Today, right now, in this service, the spirit of marital abandonment in your family line is being bound and cast into the abyss. [music] Your marriage will not fail. Your husband will not leave. Your home will not be destroyed. You are the generation that breaks the cycle. Receive it. Now, let us pray for marriage breakthroughs specifically, because miracles are needed in the area of marriage for many people. For those who are single, I decree that the magnetic force of God's favor is drawing your spouse to you right now. Not in 5 years, not in 10 years, now. The one God has prepared for you, the one who carries your complement, your completion, your destiny partner, they have been stirred in their spirit right now. They are feeling a pull. They are sensing a direction. They are being moved by an invisible hand toward the intersection where your paths will cross. Genesis chapter 24:27, "And he said, 'Blessed be the Lord God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth. I being in the way, the Lord led me to the house of my master's brethren. >> [music] >> I being in the way, the Lord led me.'" As you walk in obedience, as you walk in faithfulness, as you walk in the way the Lord will lead your spouse to you, you do not need to manipulate. You do not need to compromise. You do not need to settle. God is the original match maker and his matches are perfect. His timing is flawless. His choices are divine. I speak against every spirit that has been blocking divine connections. Every spirit of marital delay, your assignment is cancelled. Every monitoring spirit that has been watching potential relationships and destroying them before they blossom be blinded now. Be scattered now. Lose your coordination now. Every spell that has been placed on anyone's love life to make them unattractive to godly partners, I break that spell now. The glory of God is shining on your face. The favor of God is adorning your life. You are attractive. You are desirable. You are chosen. And the right person will see it. The right person will recognize it. The right person will respond to it. For those already married, Father, let the miracle of restoration enter their homes. Where love has grown cold, let the fire of your spirit rekindle it. Where communication has broken down, let the Holy Ghost become the translator. Where trust has been shattered, let the blood of Jesus become the adhesive that puts the pieces back together. No marriage under the sound of my voice will end in divorce. No home represented in this service will be destroyed by the enemy. I decree supernatural reconciliation. I decree supernatural forgiveness. I decree supernatural intimacy. I decree supernatural unity. Ephesians chapter 5:25, "Husbands, love your wives even as Christ also loved the church and gave himself for it." Let the love of Christ permeate every marriage. Let the sacrifice of Christ inspire every husband. Let the submission of the church inspire every wife. Let the unity of the Godhead be the model for every home in the name of Jesus. Now, let us move into financial miracles because many of you need money miracles. Not small money, not pocket change, real, substantial, life-changing financial miracles. And God is ready to release them. He has been ready. He has been waiting for you to create the magnetic field of faith that would attract them. Philippians chapter 4 verse 19, "But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." According to his riches, not according to the economy, not according to your salary, not according to the market, according to his riches in glory, and his riches are infinite. His resources are inexhaustible. His supply has no ceiling, no limit, no boundary. Father, I pray, release financial miracles right now. Let money come from unexpected sources. Let income multiply supernaturally. Let debts be canceled miraculously. Let business ideas drop into spirits like bombs from heaven. Let contracts appear. Let clients materialize. Let investors show up. Let promotions happen. Let salary increases manifest. Let financial doors swing open that have been sealed shut for years. I come against every spirit of financial drought. Every demon that has been assigned to keep you poor, I bind you now. I cast you out now. I strip you of your authority now. You have no power over the finances of the redeemed. >> [music] >> The blood of Jesus is against you. The word of God is against you. The fire of the Holy Ghost is consuming you. Get out of their money. Get out of their accounts. Get out of their businesses. Get out of their careers. I speak to every financial gate that has been locked. I speak to the gates of contracts be opened by fire. I speak to the gates of employment be opened by fire. I speak to the gates of business expansion be opened by fire. I speak to the gates of investment returns be opened by fire. I speak to the gates of supernatural provision be opened by fire. I speak to the gates of generational wealth be opened by fire. Isaiah chapter 45 verses 1 to 3. Thus saith the Lord to his anointed to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden to subdue nations before him. I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break [music] in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron. And I will give thee the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places that thou mayest know that I the Lord which called thee by thy name am the God of Israel. Treasures of darkness, hidden riches of secret places. God is releasing to you wealth that has been hidden, resources that have been concealed, opportunities that have been buried. They are coming to the surface now. They are being revealed now. [music] They are being directed to you now. Wealth that was not on your radar is about to appear on your radar. Money that was not in your plans is about to show up in your accounts. Provision that was not in your projections is about to exceed your projections. I decree you are entering a season of financial magnetism. Money will be drawn to you. Contracts will seek you out. Clients will find you without advertising. Customers will recommend you without being asked. Your business will grow without explanation. Your income will increase without natural cause because the hand of the Lord is upon your finances and whatever his hand touches multiplies. Pray this. I am a financial magnet. The blessing of Abraham is upon my life. Galatians chapter 3 verse 14. I attract wealth. I attract provision. I attract abundance. My hands are blessed. My endeavors are productive. I speak to every angel assigned to the life of everyone under the sound of my voice. Your mandate is activated. Go forth now. Open doors of opportunity. Close doors of destruction.
